text: INTERPRETER (tree engine, sealed runs only; the VM never runs sealed code): eval.rs dispatch_named applies seal_call before call_fn_entry for an entry with a `&mut` param, so a sealed direct call of an operator `&mut` fn is told the no-such-fn text a missing name gets instead of call_fn_entry's `&mut` refusal naming it (an existence oracle v0.22's call_fn shared; row M3495); goal.rs run_goal/run_goal_warm drop S4b's seal_call, which goal_name_is_known (a sealed caller knows only its own fns and its own kernel's provenance) already dominated with identical text, so the sealed result is unchanged (v0.22's shape). No unsealed behaviour change: seal_call is a no-op when the seal is inactive. TEST-ONLY: tests_v022_b's psv1h oracle test gains a direct-call leg and an honest control (M2622/M2623); dispatch_tests' goal-name test records an @[adaptive] operator goal in the operator's kernel and its drift test classifies goal.rs lookups as call-edged, behind goal_name_is_known or listed (M2925/M2946); taint_tests' am106 oracle gains a `&mut` operator fn pair (20 forms x 7); axon-psv sealed_frames gains a goal_eval form naming a `&mut` operator fn (M3343 re-anchored onto goal_eval's frame filter); lookup-listing reasons updated
